Dear Réka, thank you for your feedback! 🤗🐶😻 …

I would never recommend them to anyone under any circumstances.

It started with a mutt being ignored after multiple examinations, being presented with a bill of many hundreds of thousands, being sent for multiple other examinations, being watched for weeks, exposing the dog to unnecessary long suffering.

After that, multiple overbillings occurred, in other cases as well. Basically, they specialized in the removal of old people.

A report is in the process with the professional organizations.
We would like to thank Dr. Bianca for her careful care and guidance for the time to come.
They love animals, they understand them, and they understand their owners. 🙂 …

We have been going to Böszi-vet with our two dogs for many years, unfortunately we have been hugely disappointed in the past 1 year, several times.
When my dog, with whom we have been going here for at least 5 years, coughed up blood, the vet did not look at him despite repeated requests, because we did not come for an appointment, but an unexpected emergency arose.
Our other dog was diagnosed with a liver tumor almost 7 months ago, wrongly. I am glad that we finally sought the opinion of another doctor, but we do not understand why, if there was a suspicion that it was a tumor, they did not recommend that we consult a specialist? Why did they say that it was definitely a liver tumor and there was nothing to be done?
Their prices are terribly high, we have never encountered such high fees at specialists.
However, I am still grateful to Dr. Bianka when she referred me to the University of Veterinary Medicine when she felt that the problem was beyond her capabilities.
